name: UserAccessList
description: A collection of UserAccess objects that represents the user access for protected ranges.
example:
Sub UseDeleteAll()

 Dim wksSheet As Worksheet

 Set wksSheet = Application.ActiveSheet

 ' Notify the user of the number of users that can access the protected range.
 MsgBox wksSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Count

End Sub

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, AllowEdit As Boolean) As UserAccess

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the user access list.

parameters.name: AllowEdit
parameters.description: True allows users on the access list to edit the editable ranges on a protected worksheet.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Removes all users who have access to a protected range on a worksheet.
